integrity: The standalone verification script uses only the Python standard library, reconstructs direct lattice maps and checks finite instances. No independent mathematical or priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only two finite antichain levels of widths m,n>=2. Computation covers finitely many small inputs; the unrestricted claims are proved mathematically. An equivalent prior formulation cannot be ruled out without independent review.
title: Commuting nuclei and exact composite-rank profiles on two-level Heyting algebras
